questions.question_text: How are results for PTE tests typically delivered?
options: Via postal mail within two weeks.
Typically within 48 hours of taking the test.
At the end of the exam at the test center.
After a 10-day manual review process.
questions.explanation: Most test takers receive their score reports within two business days, thanks to the automated AI scoring system.

questions.question_text: What is a main advantage of using AI for scoring the Listening section?
options: It allows test takers to listen to the audio as many times as they want.
It ensures fast, accurate, and unbiased results.
It makes the test significantly longer.
It requires the test taker to grade their own responses.
questions.explanation: The use of AI-powered scoring, trained by experts, provides consistent and unbiased results without the delays associated with human marking.

questions.question_text: In the PTE Academic format, how many question types are included in the Listening section?
questions.explanation: The official test structure for PTE Academic indicates that the Listening section consists of 8 different question types.

questions.question_text: How many question types are found in the Listening section?
questions.explanation: The PTE Academic Listening section contains 8 different question types.

questions.question_text: What is a major advantage of using AI for scoring?
options: It is cheaper for the test maker
It is less biased than human grading
It allows for longer tests
It requires human interaction
questions.explanation: AI scoring reduces the risk of human error or prejudice, resulting in fairer testing.

questions.question_text: What is the typical duration for the Listening section?
options: 15-20 minutes
31-39 minutes
45-50 minutes
60+ minutes
questions.explanation: The Listening section in the PTE Academic test usually lasts between 31 and 39 minutes.

questions.question_text: When are you notified of your test results?
options: By a phone call
By mail
By email
You have to check the website manually
questions.explanation: You are notified via email when your scores are available to view in your myPTE account.

questions.question_text: What is the scale of the Global Scale of English (GSE) used in PTE?
questions.explanation: PTE Academic uses the Global Scale of English ranging from 10 to 90.

questions.question_text: What is a unique reference number (URN) used for?
options: To book the test
To verify results for UK visa applications
To get a discount on the exam
To login to your computer
questions.explanation: The URN is essential for the UK Home Office to verify your test results during the visa application process.

questions.question_text: How many seats are typically in a test center room?
options: Up to 5
Up to 15
Up to 50
Up to 100
questions.explanation: PTE test centers are designed to be small, with no more than 15 seats per room.

questions.question_text: What does a 'pass/fail' result mean for PTE Home tests?
options: You only get a grade if you fail
It measures basic proficiency rather than a score
You can only take it once
It is easier than Academic
questions.explanation: PTE Home tests are specifically designed for visa requirements where a basic pass or fail at a certain level is needed.

questions.question_text: What is the best way to prepare for the test format?
options: Read a novel
Get familiar with the test format and use official practice tools
Watch movies only
Do nothing and hope for the best
questions.explanation: Official materials provide the most accurate representation of the test's structure and scoring criteria.

questions.question_text: Can you reschedule your exam for free if done early enough?
options: No, never
Yes, if done 14 or more days before the test
Yes, if done within 24 hours of the test
Only if you have a medical certificate
questions.explanation: PTE allows free rescheduling up to 14 days before the test date.
